none: PAS FindID 944208: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17, possibly Trier mint; partly encrusted. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis left; sceptre over left shoulder. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANT] INOPOLIS. Reverse description: Victory advancing left on prow with spear and shield. In exergue: possibly…
